ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark-grey/black) background with high-intensity (off-white) punctate regions. High contrast ratio localized to circular anomalies against the dark ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed circular high-contrast blobs across the central and medial regions of both lobes. Distal left lobe exhibits localized parallel linear high-contrast streaks (approx. coordinates: far left margin).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration pattern along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations (valleys) of approximately 5-12 pixels relative to the local edge mean.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex curve along the superior margin of both lobes, terminating in irregular, slightly tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast pixel clusters (3-10 pixels in diameter) concentrated heavily in the central interior regions flanking the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct parallel diagonal high-contrast linear disruptions visible on the distal section of the left lobe lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense punctate scarring across the ventral surface; irregular tissue loss or fraying at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
